BiblicalUsage: The word is a spreading out, an expansion, and its two uses could hardly differ more: Tyre spread fine linen from Egypt to be her sail, and Job is asked whether any man can understand the spreadings of the clouds.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the contrast is the sermon: men spread their sails and call it power, but God spreads the clouds, and no one understands how.
